m1: Preserve approved clause references and source provenance.
Do not invent legal clause text.
Provide the assembled draft for downstream grounding and validation.
m4: Verify that legal content is traceable to trusted sources.

ai_transformation_rules: AI text transformation may only transform approved source text.
Any AI transformation must preserve source traceability.
AI-generated text must not introduce a new unsourced legal clause.
validation_rules: Approved clauses must remain traceable to their source references.
M4 must reject unsupported or newly introduced legal clauses.
Provenance information must be preserved through the M1 to M4 handoff.
Structural validation must confirm that the assembled draft matches the selected template and approved clause placement.
notes: M1 is responsible for deterministic assembly.
M4 performs grounding, provenance, and structural validation.
The GenerationManifest is used to preserve generation and source traceability.
Lawyer review remains part of the downstream validation flow.
